More tools

Alison Statement Grabber

For Alison payout statements

Paste an Alison payout statement. Its amounts become line items: all of them, or only the quarter's earnings. You can also paste it anywhere in the editor.

Amounts read from the statement

Which should be added as line items?

Closing balance and proposed payment are totals, so they are never added as lines. The lines replace any already on this invoice.

Columns

Add, remove, rename, reorder, resize, align, or hide columns. One column can be assigned as Quantity, Rate and Amount.

Royalty bundle splitter

For royalty statements

Splits the Name column of a royalty sheet into course and bundle. Review the result, then apply it to the invoice as line items.

Google account

Sign in with Google to keep your invoices, clients, templates and brands in your own Google Drive. Sign in on any other computer or phone to carry on where you left off.

The app can open only the folder and files it creates in your Drive, nothing else.

Your invoices, clients, brands and templates are kept in one folder in your Google Drive. Sign in with the same account on any computer or phone to carry on where you left off. Signing out keeps everything on this device.

Google Drive sync works on the hosted web version of SA Invoice Generator, not in a copy opened from your computer's disk.

Google Drive sync is not set up for this copy of the app. Everything is saved in this browser only. To set it up, see GOOGLE-DRIVE-SYNC.md.

Sync

Saves to Drive a few seconds after each change. Fetches changes from your other devices every minute, and as soon as you come back to this tab.

Google signs browser apps out after about an hour. This renews the sign-in on your next click, so syncing carries on without a Reconnect button. A Google window may flash for a moment.

Shown on your other devices, so you know where a change came from.

Backups

Google Drive folder

Everything lives in one folder in My Drive. The app can open only what it creates there.

Open folder in Google Drive
  • SA Invoice Generator
  • SA Invoice Generator - sync.json kept up to date by sync
  • Backups
  • Dated backups appear here

A backup is made on the first sync of the day (or week). Older ones are tidied away automatically, keeping one per month for a year.

Restore from Google Drive

Sign in to see your backups.

Backup file on this computer

Saves every invoice, client, template and brand to one file. Restoring adds them back and never deletes anything already here.

Invoice defaults

Ticked by default in Check and export, so the invoices board stays up to date.

The next invoice for a brand copies its last one: its number, bank details and lines, moved on to the new quarter. The due date is left for you to choose; Check and export reminds you if it is empty.
